title: intention — atomic unit of an actor's plan (living world)
description: An intention specifies WHAT, WHERE, and BY WHEN AT LATEST (deadline as T/UT), under which PRECONDITIONS, with what expected CONSEQUENCE (doc 02 §1, contract §6.2). It is also the OUTPUT FORMAT of the LLM seam agent_decide (contract §7.5): all outputs are validated against this schema THEN against invariants before entering the plan. id 'intent:<slug>' unique WITHIN an actor's PLAN (not globally). deadline is a DETERMINISTIC T (integer UT): the LLM never produces raw T — it is derived from a pinned deadline (echeance_source) via worldlib.echeance_en_t. Permissive (additionalProperties:true).

id.description: Identifier 'intent:<slug>' unique within the actor's plan (e.g., 'intent:winter-raid').

lieu.description: target location id, or null if the intention is not spatial.

echeance.description: T (UT) BY LATEST — deterministic integer. For a pinned range, this is the UPPER bound (by latest).

echeance_source.description: Original « pinned » deadline (trace), format clock.py {texte,unite,min,max,ancre,statut} OR free string. Optional — kept for audit (contract §3.9).

oneOf.description: Free string not machine-datable (e.g., « In 2-3 weeks… ») — flagged, not advanceable.

preconditions.description: Evaluable expressions — SAFE subset: numeric comparisons 'ressources.<key> <op> <number>' (e.g., 'ressources.vivres_jours < 14'). Unknown/unparseable → True (fail-open). Optional.

consequence_attendue.description: Expected effects (text). Triggers causal propagation if significant.

significativite.description: 0–1: seed for causal propagation (contract §8). Application default 0.5 if absent.

visible_par_pj.description: Can a PC observe this intention?

consequence_effets.description: Optional MACHINE deltas applied by the extended Steward (apply_consequence). All optional.

ressources.description: Resource deltas (key → number, can be negative). A violated conservation (negative resource created) causes the consequence to be REFUSED.

relations.description: Relation mutations to apply (same fields as a relation, cf. relation.schema.json).

event.description: Event template to emit (partial) — completed by tick/propagation.

relation_effet.description: Relation mutation embedded in a consequence (lightweight form of the causal graph relation).
